official.title: Secretary of War General Officer Announcements for November 20, 2026
official.summary: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth announced the president made general officer nominations.

official.title: Department of War Publishes Eighth Release of Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena Files on WAR.GOV/UFO
official.summary: The War Department published the eighth release of declassified and historical Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena files as part of the Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for UAP Encounters.

official.title: Department of War Advances Orchestration for Unmanned Vehicle Fleets
official.summary: The War Department advanced its Autonomous Vehicle Orchestrator, the software development program designed to enable a single operator to command a mixed fleet of unmanned vehicles across multiple domains.

official.title: Readout of Secretary of War Pete Hegseth's Meeting With Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa
official.summary: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth met with Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa in Quito in their third bilateral engagement, reaffirming the United States' steadfast support for Ecuador's fight against violent narco-terrorist networks.

official.title: Readout of Secretary of War Pete Hegseth's Meeting With Venezuela's President Delcy Rodriguez
official.summary: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth met with Venezuelan President Delcy Rodriguez at the Miraflores Palace in Caracas, where he reiterated his support of President Trump's three-phase plan for the country.

official.title: Readout of Secretary of War Pete Hegseth's Meeting With Colombia's Minister of National Defense Jorge Mora
official.summary: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth met with his Colombian counterpart, Minister of National Defense Jorge Mora, and the Colombian Minister of Foreign Affairs Omar Bula Escobar in Bogotá, Colombia.

official.title: Secretary of War General Officer Announcements for November 18, 2026
official.summary: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth announced general officer nominations made by the president.

official.title: Secretary of War Flag Officer Announcement for November 18, 2026
official.summary: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth announced a flag officer nomination made by the president.

official.title: Launch Of Nationwide Assessment To Dismantle Barriers To Additive Manufacturing In Defense Production
official.summary: The War Department, in partnership with the Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security, announced a national assessment to identify and dismantle the qualification cost and timeline barriers hindering the scaling of additive manufacturing across the defense industrial base.

official.title: New DoW Audit Progress Marks Breakthrough Toward a Department-Wide Clean Opinion
official.summary: The War Department released the fiscal 2026 Agency Financial Report, reflecting a new centralized approach in financial management.

official.title: Secretary of War General Officer Announcements for Nov. 16, 2026
official.summary: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth announced general officer nominations made by the president.

official.title: The Department Announces New Director of DoWEA
official.summary: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth selected Matthew Kirby as the next director of the Department of War Education Agency.

official.title: Department of War Invites Seven Industry Teams to Participate in Phase II Directed Energy Shoot-Off at Dugway Proving Ground
official.summary: Seven industry partners received invitations to participate in Phase II of the War Department's Directed Energy Counter-Unmanned Aerial Systems technology evaluation.

official.title: Department of War Redesignates CDAO as Super Intelligence Office
official.summary: The War Department announced the official redesignation of the Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office as the Department of War Super Intelligence Office.

official.title: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth Elevates Special Operations Leadership to Revitalize the Legacy of the Office of Strategic Services
official.summary: Marking a historic shift in the civilian oversight of our nation's elite forces, Secretary of War Pete Hegseth issued a memorandum to elevate the assistant secretary of war for special operations and low-intensity conflict to equal footing with the military department secretaries.

official.title: Department of War Expands Community-Based Childcare Fee Assistance
official.summary: The War Department remains focused on building and maintaining a ready, lethal fighting force prepared to dominate the battlefield and achieve peace through strength.

official.title: Readout of Secretary of War Pete Hegseth's Meeting With Poland's Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of National Defense Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz
official.summary: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth met with Poland's Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of National Defense Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz at the Pentagon.

official.title: The Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital Signs $150 Million Conditional Loan Commitment With Rocket Lab
official.summary: The War Department's Office of Strategic Capital announced a $150 million conditional loan commitment with Rocket Lab USA Inc. to support Rocket Lab's efforts to increase the flight rate of its reusable Neutron rocket beyond first launch to meet growing commercial and national security demand for access to space.

official.title: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth Orders Sweeping Overhaul of Military Education to Refocus on Combat Lethality
official.summary: In a major move to restore a culture of accountability and warfighting excellence, Secretary of War Pete Hegseth directed the comprehensive overhaul of the Department's Professional Military Education system.

official.title: Trump Administration Deepens Interagency Collaboration to Protect the Nation's Skies From Unmanned Threats
official.summary: The War Department, Department of Transportation, Department of Homeland Security, Department of Energy and Department of Justice announced an expanded interagency effort to further coordinate counter-unmanned aircraft systems operations.
